about: The whole-stream alerts (SERVICE_ALERT_MESSAGES / serviceAlert in packages/protocol, service_alert in the Rust daemon) and the test push. Both must give exactly these, word for word. Change a message only on purpose, in both places.

alerts.message: The stream is down: it isn't reaching the platforms. Jivvy keeps trying by itself; check the church computer's internet.
No sound on the stream: check the microphones and the sound desk.
Sound is back on the stream.

test.message: Test alert from Jivvy Live: alerts reach this device.
